title: QUIC and Covert: Novel HTTP/3-Powered RATs Target Southeast Asian Governments
description: A Southeast Asian cyberespionage campaign, tracked as TGR-STA-0049, targets government entities using advanced remote access trojans (RATs) PerfectPioneer and KUKURAT. These malware families employ novel HTTP/3 (QUIC) based command and control channels to evade detection. Infection vectors include exploitation of vulnerable Microsoft Exchange and web servers via web shells, as well as phishing with decoy PDFs and lookalike domains. The campaign emphasizes stealth through operational safety mechanisms and heuristic camouflage to avoid triggering security alerts. The threat actor has been active since at least 2023, with recent activity from mid-2025 to 2026 showing rapid malware evolution and expanded capabilities.
